inputExample.text: Hello world. This is a test.

usage.outputShape: body.chars, body.chars_no_spaces, body.words, body.lines, body.paragraphs, body.sentences, body.reading_time_min
quirks: Input text is passed as a URL query param (?text=...), NOT a JSON body — this is a GET endpoint.
Response includes a marketing _hint field that can be ignored.
reading_time_min is 0 for short inputs (rounded down to whole minutes).
usage.guide: Call GET https://api.x402node.dev/text/stats with the text to analyze URL-encoded into the ?text= query param (e.g. ?text=Hello%20world). Pay via x402 (USDC on Base; this run cost $0.0022). The JSON response returns counts directly at the top level: read body.words, body.chars, body.chars_no_spaces, body.lines, body.paragraphs, body.sentences, and body.reading_time_min. Ignore the _hint marketing field.
